name: ARGUS
notes: The ARGUS-Fest web pages (argus-fest.desy.de) did not respond; no ARGUS website is recorded.

summary.plain: A detector at DESY's DORIS ring in Hamburg that studied B mesons, particles containing the bottom quark. In 1987 ARGUS made the first observation of B-meson mixing, showing that a neutral B can turn into its antiparticle; it ran until about 1993.
summary.technical: ARGUS, a universal detector at the single-ring DORIS II e⁺e⁻ collider (5.6 GeV per beam, Υ region): 'Argus: A universal detector at DORIS II' (NIM A275 (1989) 1-48). First observation of B⁰-B̄⁰ mixing (1987). Operated at DORIS until 1993 per DESY.
